author: pgaudet
body:
Hi,

GO:0019251    anaerobic cobalamin biosynthetic process	 is being obsoleted and replaced by its parent: 
[cobalamin biosynthetic process](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0009236), see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31932

Can you please update InterPro:IPR010388 accordingly ? 

Thanks, Pascale
title: InterPro2GO issue: InterPro:IPR010388  & GO:0019251 anaerobic cobalamin biosynthetic process

author: pgaudet
source_title: Obsoletion notice: metabolic pathways variants with no manual annotations

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Pascale,
Thank you very much for this. I can see in our internal InterPro database that GO:0019251 has already been removed, so this change will already be available in the coming InterPro release.
I've added now the parent term GO:0009236, this will be publicly available in InterPro 110.0.
Best,
Beatriz

author: blazaropinto
body: @pgaudet no worries at all, I think the removal was done from automatic quality checks pre-release in InterPro (which include obsolete GO terms), not from an issue here, so no real duplication ;)
